name: job-research
title_zh: 简历投出去前，先让这张活网页替你盯三天招聘页
tagline_zh: 把 kariyer.net / LinkedIn / Indeed 的新职位按你的简历筛好。
tagline_en: Filters new roles from kariyer.net, LinkedIn & Indeed against your resume, then serves a live HTML dashboard.
desc_en: Searches for new job openings matching the user's resume and updates a living HTML job dashboard. Use this skill whenever the user asks to: find jobs, search for job openings, update the job dashboard, run the job search, look for QA or tech roles in Turkey, or check what's new on kariyer.net / LinkedIn / Indeed. Also trigger if the user says anything like "find me jobs", "what jobs are out there"
why_zh: 不是简单聚合——它拿你的简历当匹配基准，每次运行只挑增量职位，看板跟着更新。
why_en: Not just an aggregator—it matches listings against your actual resume, tracks only new postings, and keeps the dashboard fresh.
limit_zh: 只认土耳其站点（kariyer.net 为主）和 QA/技术岗关键词；需要你已有简历文件路径；看板是本地 HTML。
limit_en: Turkey-focused (kariyer.net etc.) & QA/tech keywords only. Needs your resume file path. Output is a local HTML—no auto-apply, no semantic matching.
title_en: Live job dashboard that watches listings for you
